content.markdown: The React and KaTeX rendering layer provides SnlSyntaxTreeView, query-driven Macro resolution, hooks, palettes, interaction and a block-renderer registry. The source also contains an internal/demo SnlSyntaxTreeEditor; it is not a package-root export. The complete Entry route is the optional entry subpath. Public imports are determined by package.json exports and their barrel declarations.
